Elaine (sales): quick heads-up — HelioMed wants to run a 2-week POC with their BioGPT-v1 variant. Asking for catalog inclusion, perf estimates, and security checklist. Can we triage?
Matt (SE): noted. couple quick Qs: model size? FP16/INT8? kv-cache behavior? tokenization (custom vocab?)
Jordan (HelioMed): thanks — model is 34B, we trained with FP16 then ran a post-train 8-bit quant. tokenizer is a slightly modified sentencepiece (adds 3 proprietary tokens).
Priya (solutions): ok — that means we should validate tokenization mapping and confirm our tokenizer adapter won't drop special tokens. Also need to confirm KV cache size growth for long-context clinical notes.
Matt (SE): agreed. initial compatibility checklist: 1) run tokenizer mapping test 2) run a 1k-token end-to-end generate to inspect kv growth 3) check soft-fallback to Mistral-32k variant for long tails.
Matt (SE): quick compatibility test command (run in staging adapter):
```
curl -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/models/compat-check \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST" \
  -F "model=@biogpt-v1.tar.gz" \
  -F "sample=@sample_1k.txt"
```
Elaine (sales): will send Jordan the artifact upload link and ask them for the sample set. Jordan — can you drop a 10-sample set with edge cases (PHI redaction, long notes)?
Jordan (HelioMed): yes, I'll upload by EOD. also need rough pricing for Dedicated pool vs hosted for expected 200 rps during peak.
Priya (solutions): rough calc: steady 50 rps, burst to 200. dedicated monthly commit estimate ballpark: $Xk — I'll run detailed estimator after we confirm sequence length distribution.
Cory (security): pinging security checklist items — we need: A) completed vendor security questionnaire (link below) B) data residency + KMS key wrap spec C) SOC2/ISO copies if requested. Jordan, are you requesting Private (VPC) deploy or hosted with customer-managed keys?
Jordan (HelioMed): prefer Private (VPC) with BYOK. Also strict logging retention controls.
Cory (security): noted. Jordan, here's the questionnaire: https://redwood.internal/sec-forms/helio-quest (fill sections 1–3). We'll need the KMS ARN and legal AML clauses for the contract.
DeployBot: scheduled a dedicated compatibility node run for biogpt-v1 on 2025-03-18 02:00 UTC (staging). Estimated runtime ~45m.
Matt (SE): follow-ups for our side: - I'll run tokenizer mapping and kv growth test once Jordan uploads samples (ETA 24h after upload) - Priya will produce dedicated vs hosted pricing breakdown - Cory will start the security intake and recontract template check.
Elaine (sales): timeline sync: Jordan uploads samples today -> we run tests tomorrow -> initial perf + recommendations by end of week. I'll update the sales deck with the risk notes (custom tokens, BYOK). :thumbsup:
Jordan (HelioMed): perfect — thanks everyone. small ask: can we get a latency SLA target? 95p token latency target ~60ms?
Matt (SE): for 34B int8 on dedicated A100-ish pool 60ms/95p per token is optimistic for single-token shot; with batching we can hit effective throughput and keep p95 for requests under 200 tokens ~80–120ms. I'll include measured numbers after the staging runs.
Priya (solutions): also flag model fallback policy: if we can't meet latency SLO during peak, suggest routing to a cheaper smaller variant for non-critical reads. Jordan — is that acceptable?
Jordan (HelioMed): yes, fallback acceptable for non-critical workloads. For PHI-parsed results we need strict routing to Private nodes only.
Cory (security): noted — add policy gating: PHI-tagged requests -> enforce VPC-only routing + no external logging. We'll draft the enforcement rule.
Elaine (sales): actionable owners: Jordan upload (Jordan), compat tests (Matt), pricing + commit options (Priya), security intake (Cory). I'll post an updated checklist later.
Matt (SE): one more perf note — if custom tokens cause tokenization mismatch, latency and token counts could spike. Please include expected tokenization examples in the sample set.
Jordan (HelioMed): will include. uploading now. thanks all. :rocket:
